import java.util.*;

public class MinCostMaxFlow {
    static final int MAXNODES = 10000;
    static final int MAXEDGES = 2000000;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int total_nodes, total_edges, max_flow, cost_value;
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, capacity, flow, cost;
        Edge(int to, int next, int capacity, int flow, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edge_list = new Edge[MAXEDGES];
    static int[] head_array = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int edge_idx;
    static int[] parent = new int[MAXNODES], dist = new int[MAXNODES];
    static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[MAXNODES];
    static int total_nodes_count;

    static void initialize(int n) {
        total_nodes_count = n;
        edge_idx = 0;
        Arrays.fill(head_array, -1);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        edge_list[edge_idx] = new Edge(v, head_array[u], cap, 0, cst);
        head_array[u] = edge_idx++;
        edge_list[edge_idx] = new Edge(u, head_array[v], 0, 0, -cst);
        head_array[v] = edge_idx++;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        dist[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        in_queue[s] = true;
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            in_queue[u] = false;
            for (int i = head_array[u]; i != -1; i = edge_list[i].next) {
                int v = edge_list[i].to;
                if (edge_list[i].capacity > edge_list[i].flow && dist[v] > dist[u] + edge_list[i].cost) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + edge_list[i].cost;
                    parent[v] = i;
                    if (!in_queue[v]) {
                        in_queue[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[t] != -1;
    }

    static int run_min_cost_max_flow(int s, int t, int[] total_cost) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        total_cost[0] = 0;
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            int min_cap = INF;
            for (int i = parent[t]; i != -1; i = parent[edge_list[i ^ 1].to]) {
                if (min_cap > edge_list[i].capacity - edge_list[i].flow)
                    min_cap = edge_list[i].capacity - edge_list[i].flow;
            }
            for (int i = parent[t]; i != -1; i = parent[edge_list[i ^ 1].to]) {
                edge_list[i].flow += min_cap;
                edge_list[i ^ 1].flow -= min_cap;
                total_cost[0] += edge_list[i].cost * min_cap;
            }
            total_flow += min_cap;
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        initialize(MAXNODES);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(0, x, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++)
                add_edge(1 + i * n, 9999, 1, i * c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                for (int gg = 1; gg <= k; gg++) {
                    add_edge(u + (j - 1) * n, v + j * n, 1, (2 * gg - 1) * d);
                    add_edge(v + (j - 1) * n, u + j * n, 1, (2 * gg - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                add_edge(i + (j - 1) * n, i + j * n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        int[] total_cost = new int[1];
        run_min_cost_max_flow(0, 9999, total_cost);
        System.out.println(total_cost[0]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
